info.title: Face Emotion Backend
info.description: Classroom auth, meeting management, WebRTC signaling, Cloudinary and AI orchestration. WebSocket protocol: docs/API.md.

post.description: Register a student or an invited teacher; emails are case-insensitive.
Return short-lived access JWT and a rotating, single-use refresh JWT.

get.description: Return the user identified by the Bearer access token.

post.description: Atomically consume the refresh token and rotate both tokens.
Revoke this refresh session; access JWT remains valid until expiration.
Create a scheduled or ongoing classroom and enroll its owner.
Resolve a room code and join atomically; no public participant directory.

get.description: Get meeting and membership states; restricted to members and owner.

post.description: Idempotently join; keep the same membership record when rejoining.
Mark membership left and close any active socket; retain the record.
Owning teacher starts a scheduled classroom.
End the classroom, mark all memberships left and close room sockets.
Upload a raw video body (not multipart). RAM-only buffering with hard limits.

get.description: Get recording metadata, restricted to the meeting's owning teacher.
Generate a signed five-minute download URL for the authenticated asset.

post.description: Persist an analysis job. Idempotent while pending/processing/completed; failed jobs may retry.

get.description: Poll durable status every two seconds until completed or failed.

post.description: REST fallback for WebSocket FRAME; shares the same rate limit.

get.description: Get recording analysis; return an empty report with current status when unavailable.
Weighted sample distribution. Auto prefers completed batch data, otherwise realtime; never merges sources.
Liveness only; no external service requests.
